explanation: From main: The catalog drops the statistics and compare-datasets views and the datasources tab, and re-describes the acknowledgements, methodology and statistics modules. CONTEXT.md, PROJECT_GUIDANCE, REAL_DATA_SHAPES and REFACTOR_CHECKLIST stop naming the removed pages. /how-to-cite/ gains the software and acknowledgements section. From the cross-study listing: CONTEXT.md defines significance tier, listing mode and cross-study listing. The UI change workflow and the refactor checklist name listCrossStudy as the one place a cross-study view gets what leads, its order and its counts, and TierLabel in src/statistics as its label. The catalog adds both files to the statistics area and drops GroupSummary.
